title: Fix failing api package tests
description: go test ./... currently fails in api tests expecting legacy session REST endpoints (/sessions) and WebSocket httptest behavior. Update tests or restore route coverage so the full test suite passes.

title: Browser MCP: check console errors and network requests
description: Use browser MCP across all pages. Capture console messages and network requests. Check for: GraphQL errors, WebSocket connection failures, CORS errors, hydration mismatches, missing assets.
acceptance_criteria: Zero console errors on load. WebSocket connects successfully. No CORS failures. No 404 assets.

title: Browser MCP: test watch page live subscription
description: Use browser MCP. Navigate to /watch/<sessionId> with a valid session. Verify: grid renders, stats panel shows battery/parks/moves, session ID shown with copy button. Then trigger a move via GraphQL (curl or playground) and verify page updates without refresh.
acceptance_criteria: Grid renders on load. Stats update live after move mutation. No WebSocket errors in console.

title: Browser MCP: test create session flow
description: Use browser MCP on http://localhost:5173. Click '+ New Session', pick a config, click Create. Verify: session created, ID shown, curl/MCP snippets displayed, Watch button links to /watch/<id>.
acceptance_criteria: createSession mutation succeeds. Session ID shown. Watch button navigates to /watch/<id>.

title: Browser MCP: test lobby page renders and loads sessions
description: Use browser MCP to load http://localhost:5173. Verify: header renders with LIVE badge, sessions list loads (or empty state shown), no console errors, configs load in create-session modal.
acceptance_criteria: Page loads without JS errors. Session cards visible or empty state shown. Create session modal opens, configs dropdown populated.

title: Frontend: Watch page (/watch/:sessionId)
description: Full session view. Left: large grid render, car overlay, crash overlay, visited parks dimmed, trail dots. Right: stats cards (Battery, Parks, Moves, Status), session id + copy, message stream (last 5), config card. Bottom strip: other sessions on same config. Single WS sub sessionState(id).
acceptance_criteria: Loading by URL works. Reconnect on WS drop. Crash/victory states render. Other-sessions strip updates live.
close_reason: Watch page live: sessionUpdated subscription, full grid render, cave mode, stats panel, message stream.

title: Frontend: Lobby page (/)
description: Public hub showing all live sessions as cards. Each card: session id, mini grid, battery bar, parks x/total, moves, status dot, config tag. Filter by config + sort. Click card -> /watch/<id>. CTA to create session. Stream via lobbyUpdates subscription.
acceptance_criteria: Page lists all sessions live. Updates push without refresh. Filter + sort work. Empty state shown when no sessions.
close_reason: Lobby page live: sessions query + 10s poll, session cards with battery bar, create-session modal wired to createSession mutation.

title: Frontend scaffold in /frontend
description: Create /frontend dir. Init chosen stack from ADR. Add Tailwind. Add GraphQL client + graphql-ws. Env: VITE_GRAPHQL_URL, VITE_WS_URL. Set up GraphQL codegen against backend schema. Add npm scripts: dev, build, preview.
acceptance_criteria: npm run dev runs locally against backend on 8080. npm run build produces static artifacts in /frontend/dist or build/. README in /frontend explains setup.
close_reason: SvelteKit scaffold in /frontend. Tailwind, urql, graphql-ws installed. Dev proxy to :8080 wired. Build produces /frontend/build/ via adapter-static.

title: Backend: sessions list query + summary type
description: Add query sessions(configName?, status?) returning SessionSummary { id, configName, battery, maxBattery, parksCollected, parksTotal, moves, status, gridSize }. Backs lobby grid. Used by lobby query + lobbyUpdates sub.
acceptance_criteria: Query returns all active sessions. Filter args work. Type ready to feed subscription.
close_reason: sessions query already existed. Subscription resolvers use existing SessionList/GameState types.

title: Backend: formalize GraphQL subscriptions
description: Add gqlgen subscriptions: sessionState(sessionId), lobbyUpdates (all sessions diff stream), optional globalMoves. Use graphql-ws transport over /graphql. Keep existing /ws for backwards compat during transition.
acceptance_criteria: Schema defines Subscription type. Resolvers wire to existing session hub. graphql-ws works via gqlcli or wscat. Subscriptions emit on state change.
close_reason: GraphQL subscriptions: sessionUpdated(sessionID) and lobbyUpdated. Hub.SubscribeSession/SubscribeLobby added. graphql-ws transport wired in main.go.

title: Decide frontend stack + write ADR
description: Pick frontend framework. Constraint: not React, plays well with Go GraphQL backend, static-hostable, small bundle, supports WS subscriptions. Candidates: SvelteKit (static adapter), SolidStart, plain Vite+Svelte, htmx+Alpine. Output ADR in docs/adr/0001-frontend-stack.md.
acceptance_criteria: ADR committed. Stack chosen. Justification covers: bundle size, WS support, GraphQL client option, static deploy, dev DX.
close_reason: ADR written at docs/adr/0001-frontend-stack.md. SvelteKit static + Tailwind + urql + graphql-ws.

title: Spectator UI v2 — public read-only web app
description: Replace current play UI with public spectator UI. Read-only watch + create-session only. Cave mode kept. WS-driven. Hosted on AWS (S3/CloudFront + Fargate). Frontend lives in /frontend dir. Stack: SvelteKit static export + Tailwind + graphql-ws + urql.

title: Redesign index landing page
description: Add an index landing page that explains the Tesla Road Trip Game idea, provides clear action buttons to create/resume sessions and related pages, and includes a footer site map.
close_reason: Implemented redesigned static index landing page with game explanation, session action buttons, map preview, dashboard compatibility, AI/tools menu, and footer site map.

title: Browser MCP: test navigation and routing
description: Use browser MCP. Verify SPA routing: / -> /learn -> /watch/<id> -> / all work without full page reload. Back button works. Direct URL navigation to /watch/<id> and /learn works.
acceptance_criteria: All routes resolve. No 404s. Back/forward browser navigation works. Direct URL access works.

title: Browser MCP: test learn page content and links
description: Use browser MCP on http://localhost:5173/learn. Verify all sections render: game rules, cell emoji grid, how-AI-plays steps, try-it-yourself snippets, strategies. Check links: Lobby, GraphQL Playground (/playground), llms.txt all reachable.
acceptance_criteria: All sections visible. No broken layouts. External links reachable. Code snippets readable.

title: Browser MCP: test cave mode toggle on watch page
description: Use browser MCP on /watch/<sessionId>. Toggle cave mode checkbox. Verify cells outside radius go dark. Change radius slider. Verify fog radius updates. Reload page and verify settings persisted via localStorage.
acceptance_criteria: Toggle darkens/reveals cells. Radius slider changes fog boundary. Settings survive page reload.

title: Deploy: wire frontend env vars + CORS
description: Frontend reads VITE_GRAPHQL_URL + VITE_WS_URL at build. Backend allows CORS from production origin. graphql-ws origin check honors CORS settings.
acceptance_criteria: Prod frontend talks to prod backend. No CORS errors. WS upgrade succeeds cross-origin.

title: Deploy: Backend on Fargate behind ALB with WSS
description: Containerize Go server. Push to ECR. Fargate service behind ALB. ALB target group with WS support. HTTPS+WSS via ACM. Env vars for config dir. Health check on /healthz (add if missing).
acceptance_criteria: Backend reachable publicly via HTTPS + WSS. Sessions persist while task running. Health check green.

title: Deploy: S3 + CloudFront for frontend
description: Static site hosting. S3 bucket private, CloudFront OAC. Domain via Route53 (TBD). HTTPS via ACM. Build artifacts uploaded via CI. SPA fallback (404 -> index.html).
acceptance_criteria: Frontend reachable at public URL via HTTPS. SPA routes resolve. Cache invalidation on deploy.

title: Frontend: Learn page (/learn)
description: AI-learning content. Sections: game rules, how an AI plays (loop diagram), try-it-yourself with endpoints + curl/gqlcli/MCP snippets, strategies pulled from docs/ai-strategy.md, links to /llms.txt and /playground. Optional live ticker showing recent moves across sessions (WS globalMoves).
acceptance_criteria: All sections rendered. Snippets copy-paste-runnable. Links work.
close_reason: Learn page at /learn. Sections: game rules, how AI plays, try-it-yourself snippets, strategies.

title: Frontend: Create-session modal
description: Modal from lobby CTA. Picks config, posts createSession mutation, shows resulting session id + curl/gqlcli/MCP snippets so user can point their AI at it. Then offer Watch button -> /watch/<id>.
acceptance_criteria: Mutation works. Snippets shown with copy buttons. Rate-limit errors surfaced cleanly.
close_reason: Create-session modal in lobby page: config picker, mutation, session ID display with snippets.

title: Frontend: Cave Mode component
description: Viewer-side fog-of-war. Toggle + radius slider (1-10). Chebyshev distance from player pos. Cells outside radius darkened/hidden. Reveal animation on newly visible cells. Persist toggle+radius per-tab via localStorage. Reusable across watch page + lobby card previews.
acceptance_criteria: Toggle works. Slider changes radius live. Settings survive reload. Label clarifies fog is viewer-only, not AI view.
close_reason: CaveMode.svelte — toggle, radius slider, localStorage persist. Viewer-side fog only.

title: Frontend: shared layout, design system, Tesla theme
description: Implement base layout: header with logo + 'Live' badge, footer with links to /learn, /playground, /llms.txt. Tailwind config with Tesla palette (white/gray), Inter font. Reusable components: BatteryBar, StatCard, SessionCard, GridRender, ConnectionBadge.
close_reason: Base layout with header, nav, footer. Tesla theme, Inter font, BatteryBar via inline Tailwind. CaveMode component.

title: Backend: rate-limit createSession by IP
description: Public createSession endpoint open to world. Add per-IP rate limit (e.g., 5/min, 50/day). Use in-memory token bucket. Return GraphQL error with retry hint.
acceptance_criteria: Burst over limit returns error. Limit configurable via env. Smoke test passes.

title: Docs: update README + ui-pages-description for new UI
description: Rewrite docs/ui-pages-description.md to describe new spectator UI. Update top-level README with deployment + frontend instructions.

title: Cleanup: remove or quarantine old play UI
description: Once new UI is live: delete static/index.html, static/game.js, config-builder.html OR move to /legacy. Update Go embed paths. Keep /llms.txt, /playground untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Old UI removed from default route. Backend serves new SPA or redirects to it.
close_reason: Deferred. Old static/ UI still served by Go; clean up when new UI deployed and verified.
